key.name: recent-repositories
key.description: Paths only. Open repositories are never cached as live handles — a cached handle keeps its packfile mappings and object cache alive, which is a leak wearing a convenience feature's clothes.

key.name: commit-row-budget
key.summary: Maximum commit rows held in memory
key.description: Rows outside this budget are dropped and re-read on demand. Raising it trades memory for fewer re-reads when scrolling long distances.

key.name: last-page
key.description: The page that was open when the window last closed, so relaunching lands where the user left off.

key.name: diff-side-by-side
key.summary: Show diffs side by side rather than unified

key.name: cache-max-age-days
key.summary: Days to retain cached API responses
key.description: Cached responses let the app render real data while offline and let revalidation happen without spending rate limit. Zero disables the cache.
